title: Accounting and Tax Services for Optometrists

rows.before: We incorporated an Optometry Professional Corporation with a COO Certificate of Authorization, rolled the practice in on a section 85 election, set a salary-and-dividend mix using the $500,000 small business deduction at 12.2%, issued non-voting family shares within the TOSI rules, and established an Individual Pension Plan the OPC deducts.
rows.after: We incorporated an Optometry Professional Corporation with a COO Certificate of Authorization, rolled the practice in on a section 85 election, set a salary-and-dividend mix using the $500,000 small business deduction at 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), issued non-voting family shares within the TOSI rules, and established an Individual Pension Plan the OPC deducts.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

page_note: All 12.2% occurrences are in case-study cards; no JSON-LD, meta or calculator occurrences. No 3.2%, 0.122, 0.032 or $600K found.
